cybermole-jobs.description: cybermole's scheduled jobs: list, create, edit, delete and validate jobs, read run history and logs, run now, kill a live run, and list apps for the job tag picker.

cybermole-apps.description: cybermole's app build loop (root agents): scaffold an app from the image starter template, check it green (astro check + tsc + unit tests + build, one quiet envelope), build it, register/unregister its row, reload the app host (the sync point), and see per-app status (registered, mounted, serving reason, build-stale, unregistered trees).
